title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

title: Jeete Hai Shaan Se
desc: Friends Johny, Govinda, and Iqbal work to serve their community, but when tensions rise between Johny and Govinda, Iqbal intervenes before their greatest enemy exploits the rift.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: State Of Siege: Temple Attack
desc: Armed with advanced gear and a daring plan, NSG commandos storm into action to save innocent civilians trapped in a brutal terrorist attack at a Gujarat temple, risking everything to protect lives.

title: Mission Majnu
desc: During the 1971 Indo-Pakistani War, a RAW agent infiltrates Pakistan to expose nuclear plans. He must alert India while avoiding disaster, risking everything to protect his nation's future.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Sky Force
desc: India and Pakistan engage in escalating airstrikes. Amid deadly consequences, individuals seek the truth behind the war, navigating chaos, patriotism, and survival in times of conflict.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.
